create_NeuralBandit: create a NeuralBandit policy learner with a VanillaValueNetwork model and AdamW optimizer for contextual bandit tasks
learn_batch_NeuralBandit: train the NeuralBandit model on a TransitionBatch and return predictions, labels, weights, and loss
act_NeuralBandit: select an action using the NeuralBandit policy given a subjective state and discrete action space
get_scores_NeuralBandit: get predicted value scores for all actions in a discrete action space given a subjective state
compare_NeuralBandit: compare two NeuralBandit instances and return a string describing differences in model, optimizer, and attributes
